title: Writing --- With A Clock
label: ch:hi-ghadi-ke-saath
canDo: I can complete the A1 writing paper's two tasks inside its published twenty minutes, filling every form field and keeping the message between thirty and forty words.

payoff.summary: Complete HI-W10-a1-con-reloj: seven minutes for the form and thirteen for the message, then count the words and check the form for blanks before mistakes.
payoff.note: Timing, task count, field count and word range are read out of this track's own task-shapes/a1.json, not invented for the lesson.
